Veterans - United States Congressman Pete Sessions Veterans Veterans of our armed services deserve our nation’s gratitude, support, and care. The federal government should be attentive to providing resources that support veterans' needs as they transition from active duty. I commit my efforts in Congress to ensure our former servicemen and women receive care and benefits that reflect the country’s appreciation for their sacrifice. Some of my efforts include: H.R. 8736  – GUARD VA Benefits Act | This bill imposes criminal penalties and/or fines on individuals for soliciting, contracting for, charging, or receiving any unauthorized fee or compensation with respect to the preparation, presentation, or prosecution of any claim for Department of Veterans Affairs benefits.  H.R. 6659  – Health Care for Burn Pit Veterans Act | This bill updates policies and procedures related to Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) health care and benefits for veterans who have been exposed to toxic substances. H.R. 3363  – VA Canine Reporting Act of 2023 | This bill requires the Department of Veterans Affairs to report on the average time it took to provide a veteran with a service or guide dog in the prior year. The report must also include legislative recommendations to reduce such wait time. More on Veterans There are no records to display that match the provided criteria. ICYMI: Congressman Pete Sessions Launches Bipartisan Military & Veteran Housing Caucus - Press Releases - United States Congressman Pete Sessions Press Releases ICYMI: Congressman Pete Sessions Launches Bipartisan Military & Veteran Housing Caucus August 4, 2026 WASHINGTON, D.C. — Congressman Pete Sessions (TX-17) announced the launch of the bipartisan Military & Veteran Housing Caucus (MVHC), a congressional caucus dedicated to advancing policies that strengthen financial readiness, military-to-civilian transition, homeownership, economic mobility, and housing stability for servicemembers, veterans, and military families. Congressman Sessions will serve as the caucus' Republican Co-Chair alongside Democratic Co-Chair Congresswoman Susie Lee (NV-03). Congressmen Juan Ciscomani (AZ-06), Tom Suozzi (NY-03), Dale Strong (AL-05), and Gil Cisneros (CA-31) will serve as Vice Chairs, creating a truly bipartisan leadership team committed to addressing the housing and financial challenges facing the military-connected community.  Military and veteran housing issues span multiple congressional committees, making it difficult for any single committee to address them comprehensively. The Military & Veteran Housing Caucus was established to provide a dedicated forum for education, collaboration, and bipartisan solutions that improve housing stability, financial readiness, and homeownership opportunities for servicemembers, veterans, and their families.  One of the caucus' main priorities is addressing the unique housing and financial challenges faced by the military-connected community. Frequent relocations, credit-building challenges, and limited awareness of earned benefits can create barriers to homeownership and long-term financial security. Although the VA Home Loan Program is one of the nation's most valuable benefits for veterans, only an estimated fifteen percent of eligible veterans utilize it. STATEMENT ON THE U.S. MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING WITH IRAN - Press Releases - United States Congressman Pete Sessions Press Releases STATEMENT ON THE U.S. MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING WITH IRAN June 18, 2026   "The memorandum of understanding (MOU), signed by President Trump, is now publicly available to the American people for review. It deserves critique by people who want the outcome to place America and her allies in a safer future.  It is important that the lead negotiator for the Administration, Vice President JD Vance, be given an opportunity to provide a full accounting of the negotiations. Any agreement to financially empower an unstable Iranian regime that hates America and her allies would seemingly hand it the means to potentially grow into a regional superpower. Any outcome that arises from this agreement must be one that respects its neighbors and the stability of the region.  My review of the MOU raises serious questions that must be answered before this is finalized, and I believe the Administration's own negotiators owe the American people visibility. I look forward to hearing from Vice President JD Vance and his negotiating team. They should be clear about what the Iranians walk away with and what the new future will look like. The American people deserve to have these answers to key consequential issues relating to our global security.These are the conditions of peace that withstand the tests of time. May God bless Texas, and may God bless the United States of America." ### Congressman Pete Sessions (TX-17) has been a Member of Congress for 28-years. He is a member of the House Financial Services Committee and House Oversight and Accountability Committee. Congressman Pete Sessions (TX-17) Announces Federal Partnership with Texas Agriculture Commissioner Sid Miller to Establish Agriculture Freedom Zones Nationwide - Press Releases - United States Congressman Pete Sessions Press Releases Congressman Pete Sessions (TX-17) Announces Federal Partnership with Texas Agriculture Commissioner Sid Miller to Establish Agriculture Freedom Zones Nationwide February 25, 2026 WASHINGTON, D.C.  — Congressman Pete Sessions today announced a formal federal partnership with Texas Agriculture Commissioner Sid Miller to advance legislation establishing Agriculture Freedom Zones (AFZs) nationwide, recognizing that food security is national security and must be treated as a strategic federal priority. Farmland is the foundation of America’s food security, and the families who steward that land sustain our national strength through its productive use. The proposed legislation will create a voluntary, incentive-based federal framework designed to protect America’s most productive farmland while responsibly guiding large-scale development toward areas less critical to domestic food production. The initiative reflects growing concerns about the rapid conversion of prime agricultural land and the long-term implications for America’s supply chain resilience, water resources, and national sovereignty. Agriculture Freedom Zones would align federal tax policy with strategic land-use priorities by encouraging resource-intensive development, such as data centers, renewable energy facilities, and other major infrastructure projects, to locate in marginal lands, brownfields, arid regions, or areas with existing infrastructure capacity. By doing so, the policy seeks to preserve irreplaceable farm and ranchland that underpins America’s domestic food supply. Congressman Pete Sessions Secures $750,000 for Pflugerville Water Infrastructure, Announces Funding at Press Conference with Mayor Doug Weiss - Press Releases - United States Congressman Pete Sessions Press Releases Congressman Pete Sessions Secures $750,000 for Pflugerville Water Infrastructure, Announces Funding at Press Conference with Mayor Doug Weiss February 6, 2026 FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE February 6, 2026 Congressman Pete Sessions Secures $750,000 for Pflugerville Water Infrastructure, Announces Funding at Press Conference with Mayor Doug Weiss Pflugerville, TX  – Today, Congressman Pete Sessions held a press conference alongside Pflugerville Mayor Doug Weiss to announce $750,000 in federal funding he secured for the City of Pflugerville’s Pump Station and Storage Tank Project, a critical investment in local water infrastructure that will support current needs and future growth. The funding was included in H.R. 6938, the Commerce, Justice, Science; Energy and Water Development; and Interior and Environment Appropriations Act for Fiscal Year 2026, which passed both chambers of Congress and was signed into law by the President on January 23, 2026. This investment will help modernize Pflugerville’s water system, strengthen reliability, and ensure the city can continue to serve residents and businesses as the community grows. The project reflects the importance of proactive infrastructure planning to protect public health and sustain economic development across Texas’ 17th Congressional District. Speaking at today’s press conference, Congressman Sessions highlighted his efforts to deliver results for Pflugerville and communities across TX-17, emphasizing that federal appropriations should prioritize projects with clear, local impact. " This investment ensures that our infrastructure keeps pace with growth and that our community continues to receive safe, reliable water service, " said Pflugerville Mayor Doug Weiss . " Congressman Sessions, thank you again for your partnership, your commitment to our city, and your continued support of the communities you serve. Congressman Sessions Statement on Schumer Shutdown - Press Releases - United States Congressman Pete Sessions Press Releases Congressman Sessions Statement on Schumer Shutdown September 30, 2025 WASHINGTON, D.C.– Congressman Pete Sessions (TX-17) released the following statement after Senate Democrats voted against the House-passed Continuing Resolution. As a result, the federal government will shut down at midnight. Congressman Sessions said,   "House Republicans did our job to keep the government open and avoid a shutdown. In the past, when Congress reached this point, we have come together to pass a clean continuing resolution so negotiations could continue without hurting the American people. This time, Democrats chose a different path. By blocking the short-term stopgap we passed last week, they have blocked paychecks for our servicemembers, denied veterans timely access to care at the VA, and added unnecessary burden on American taxpayers. I urge my Democrat colleagues to come to the negotiating table to end this shutdown and get the government open for the people we serve.
